gtoecore.clone.tooltip.1: Hold and right-click in air to bind to yourself
gtoecore.clone.tooltip.2: Place in a Clone Production Workshop's input bus:
gtoecore.clone.tooltip.3: consumes 1 clone to revive you on the bed upon hardcore death
gtoecore.clone.no_clone: No usable clone in the workshop's input bus, cannot revive!
gtoecore.machine.clone_production_worksh: Put clones in the input bus: on hardcore death, consumes 1 to revive you on the bed
Right-click a clone in air to bind it to a player; unbound clones work for anyone
gtoecore.machine.clone_manufacturing_cha: Grows 1 Bio-cluster every 5 minutes once formed (needs an output bus)
gtoecore.gravity_core.tooltip.1: Station cabin main block: place inside a cabin and right-click to scan its airtight volume
gtoecore.gravity_core.tooltip.2: Once active: normal gravity inside the cabin, zero-G (free camera) outside
gtoecore.gravity_core.tooltip.3: Right-click again to rescan; breaks when the core is removed or unloaded
gtoecore.gravity_core.no_air: No air around the core, cannot scan a cabin!
gtoecore.gravity_core.active: Cabin gravity online, airtight volume %s blocks
gtoecore.gravity_core.leak: Cabin is not airtight (scan leaked or exceeded %s blocks), gravity offline!
gtoecore.machine.solar_array_module.tool: 7x7x1 structure: solid steel casings as the frame (energy output hatches allowed), PV panels (bottom slabs) in the inner 5x5, gaps allowed
Every 4 sky-visible PV panels generate 1A LV (32 EU/t); 25 panels = 192 EU/t
Only works during daytime, clear weather, in dimensions with sky; shaded panels reduce output
Extract power from energy output hatches; removing panels does not break the structure
gtoecore.solar.status.3: Status: no sky in this dimension, cannot generate
gtoecore.drone.type.survey: Survey drone: runs recon & mapping tasks
gtoecore.drone.type.mining: Mining drone: runs drilling & gathering tasks
gtoecore.drone.tooltip.tier: Drone Swarm Heart consumable - Voltage tier %s
gtoecore.machine.drone_swarm_heart.toolt: A downgraded electric take on the HPCA: commands drone swarms on space mining and deep space exploration missions

Structure: 5x5x8 - Primitive Computer Casing shell, Primitive Computer Heat Vent gills on the side walls, Primitive Empty HPCA Components filling the interior around a Primitive HPCA Computation Component core
Casing slots accept Energy Hatches (1-2), a Maintenance Hatch (required) and item/fluid IO hatches; put survey/mining drones of the matching voltage tier in the input bus to run recipes
Central core of the deep space system: powers and aggregates modules within 16 blocks
Runs on 1A of its own voltage and consumes 1 Deep Space Fuel Cell every 80 ticks
Cutting power or fuel instantly shuts down every module on the network
Structure 7x7x11: smooth quartz shell, deepslate tile floor, gray glass windows, cyan terracotta core
gtoecore.machine.deep_space_module.toolt: Auto-attaches within 16 blocks of a Deep Space Hub; stack unlimited copies for stronger effects
gtoecore.item.deep_space_fuel.tooltip: Operating fuel for the Deep Space Hub - 1 consumed every 80 ticks
gtoecore.deepspace.hub.offline: §cNetwork offline: no power or fuel, modules halted
gtoecore.deepspace.module.attached: Attached: network tier %s / same kind %s / total %s
gtoecore.deepspace.module.detached: §cDetached: not within 16 blocks of any Deep Space Hub
gtoecore.deepspace.module.net_bonus: Network bonus: parallel +%s / duration x%s / EU x%s / output x%s
gtoecore.machine.rotary_mill.tooltip.1: Rotation energy (RU) consumer: attach to an axle, driven by pushed rpm
gtoecore.machine.rotary_mill.tooltip.2: Right-click with raw ore to insert; empty hand to take output
gtoecore.machine.rotary_mill.tooltip.3: Stalls below required rpm (no drain); higher rpm grinds faster
gtoecore.machine.gtoe_energy_input_hatch: GT6-flavor energy hatch: place on a multiblock energy slot (same as EU hatch)
Adjacent axle/heat/cold/kinetic conduits push energy in
Recipe conditions read live value: below requirement the recipe stalls, above it runs
gtoecore.machine.combustion_engine.toolt: GT6-flavor RU producer: burns fuel to output rotation (RU) and heat (HU)
Fuel slot auto-consumes burnables; one item = 2 minutes, quality sets rpm tier
Attach axle/heat pipe on any side to export energy
gtoecore.machine.cryogenic_condenser.too: Electric cold (CU) producer: 32 EU/t max output 96 K
gtoecore.machine.pneumatic_compressor.to: Electric kinetic (KU) producer: 32 EU/t max output 256 kPa
gtoecore.machine.magnetic_coil.tooltip.1: Electric magnetic (MU) producer: 32 EU/t max output 48 T
gtoecore.machine.laser_focus.tooltip.1: Electric laser (LU) producer: 64 EU/t max output 2048 W + 8 mB/t laser fluid
gtoecore.machine.quantum_condenser.toolt: Quantum (QU) producer: 64 EU/t + 2 mB/t laser fluid -> 64 QU + 1 mB/t quantum fluid
gtoecore.machine.laser_pipe.tooltip.1: Laser (LU) pipe: straight line only, cannot bend (matches GT laser pipe)
gtoecore.machine.laser_pipe.tooltip.2: Place against laser focus / receiver; energy travels in a straight line
gtoecore.machine.quantum_pipe.tooltip.1: Quantum (QU) pipe: emits purple glow when energy flows
gtoecore.machine.quantum_pipe.tooltip.2: Mek-style pipe; glow fades when supply stops
gtoecore.machine.lumina_fusion_core.tool: Identical to GT Fusion Reactor in structure and logic, produces Fusion Light (photon source for Luminofluid)
Requires eu_to_start preheat; feed EU via energy hatches, fusion fuel via fluid hatches, output fusion light fluid
gtoecore.machine.solar_concentrator.tool: Solar Concentrator: focuses Fusion Light into a collimated laser beam (LU value)
Input = Fusion Light fluid + sustaining EU (stops on power loss); output via laser pipe / energy hatch
4x the output of a same-tier Laser Focus; overclock = power x4 / output x2, fluid cost x4
All 15 tiers; internal buffer scales with tier (8 000 mB x 2^tier, cap 2e9)
tooltip.gtoecore.hull_viewport.1: One-way viewport: see-through from inside, solid from outside.
tooltip.gtoecore.hull_viewport.2: A redstone signal opens the whole connected hull as an outward ripple; powering down reverses it.
tooltip.gtoecore.hull_viewport.3: Inner face is auto-detected on placement; sneak + empty-hand right-click to flip it.
gtoecore.machine.event_horizon_engine.to: A 35x35x35 spherical wireframe cage hosting a black hole with an accretion disk
The equatorial ring is the bus belt: put energy / item / fluid / maintenance hatches there
Keep the cage hollow - filling it in hides the event horizon
gtoecore.machine.event_horizon_engine.mo: Click to switch: 1 = black hole lens / 2 = corona sphere
tooltip.gtoecore.hull_panel_hex.1: Solid hull block: honeycomb lattice on all six faces, pattern continuous across blocks.
tooltip.gtoecore.hull_panel_hex.2: A redstone signal turns the whole connected hull semi-transparent as an outward ripple; powering down reverses it.
gtoecore.machine.ae_crafting_terminal.to: An AE2 crafting terminal, built as a multiblock machine (3x3x3 deoxidized steel shell)
Right-click the controller to open the AE crafting terminal UI
Connect an ME cable to access the grid
tooltip.gtoecore.turbine_demo.1: Forge OBJ pipeline demo: external .obj asset rendered by a BER
tooltip.gtoecore.turbine_demo.2: Right-click to cycle rotor speed (stop / slow / fast / reverse)
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.tooltip.1: A single 43x23 layer of solid steel casing - the controller sits in the middle of the front edge, the tower stands on the centre of the base
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.tooltip.2: Burns liquid fuel for EU: pipe diesel / gasoline / natural gas into the fluid input hatch. Uses native GT recipes (visible in JEI).
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.tooltip.3: The tower appears once the structure is formed and spawns its own invisible collision volume (you can bump into it, stand on it, but not walk inside). The tower base always sits flush on top of the base layer and never probes for blocks you built.
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.tooltip.4: Any block of the base can be swapped for a hatch; put them on the outermost ring (stand on that ring and look down to open them): energy output hatch (required), fluid input hatch, maintenance hatch
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.tooltip.5: The 4-stage turbine inside (22/20/18/16 blades) and the top exhaust wheel follow the machine state: fast while burning fuel, slowly idling otherwise
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.display: Tower Rig Power Tower: structure formed, tower raised
gtoecore.machine.tower_rig.incomplete: Structure incomplete: needs at least 1 energy output hatch on the base (required), plus a fluid input hatch
gtoecore.machine.arch_rig.tooltip.1: A single 31x19 layer of solid steel casing (one ring wider than the tower footprint): the controller sits in the middle of the front edge, the arch tower stands on the centre of the base
gtoecore.machine.arch_rig.tooltip.2: Structure and looks only for now - no recipe logic. The tower appears once the structure is formed and spawns its own invisible collision volume (you can bump into it, stand on it, but not walk inside).
gtoecore.machine.arch_rig.tooltip.3: The tower base always sits flush on top of the base layer and never probes for blocks you built. An optional maintenance hatch can go anywhere on the base - the outermost ring is recommended (stand on it and look down to open it).

gtoecore.machine.lhc_combo.incomplete: Structure incomplete: only the controller block itself is needed (this machine has no base)
gtoecore.machine.maimai_rig.tooltip.1: A tiny 1x2 base (the controller itself plus 1 steel casing in front of it) - the only machine whose base is NOT derived from the collision footprint + one ring: an arcade cabinet should sit on the ground like a piece of furniture
gtoecore.machine.maimai_rig.tooltip.2: Structure and looks only for now - no recipe logic. The cabinet appears once the structure is formed and spawns its own invisible collision volume (you can bump into it, stand on it, but not walk inside).
gtoecore.machine.maimai_rig.tooltip.3: A small base does NOT mean small collision: the collision volume is voxelised from the whole 9.5x9.8x7.4 block machine (385 cells), reaching 5 blocks left/right, 4/3 front/back and 10 blocks up from the controller
gtoecore.machine.cms_rig.tooltip.1: A single 115x77 layer of solid steel casing (one ring wider than the detector footprint): the controller sits in the middle of the front edge, the CMS detector stands on the centre of the base
gtoecore.machine.cms_rig.tooltip.2: Structure and looks only for now - no recipe logic. The detector appears once the structure is formed and spawns its own invisible collision volume (you can bump into it, stand on it, but not walk inside).
gtoecore.machine.cms_rig.tooltip.3: The collision volume was optimised (enclosed cavities filled, only a one-block shell kept): 142,752 -> 95,061 cells. An optional maintenance hatch can go anywhere on the base - the outermost ring is recommended.
gtoecore.machine.lhc_combo.tooltip.1: No base at all: just place the controller block and the structure forms - the 203-block-diameter collider ring sits straight on the ground
gtoecore.machine.lhc_combo.tooltip.2: The ring is about 203x203x45 blocks and spans 13x13 chunks - by far the largest multiblock in this mod (the model's own 205x205 floor slab floats about 4 blocks up, so you can walk underneath it)
gtoecore.machine.lhc_combo.tooltip.3: Structure and looks only for now - no recipe logic. Forming spawns the invisible collision volume of the whole ring (123,362 cells - you can bump into it, stand on it, but not walk inside).
gtoecore.machine.lhc_combo.tooltip.4: ⚠ Render distance is widened to 512 blocks and the whole ring is baked into VRAM in one go (about 59k faces ~ 7.5 MB); the first time it enters view there is a brief hitch.
